new_cluster._spark_version_note: Must match a Databricks Runtime version actually available in the target workspace at submission time — 17.3 LTS was the current LTS release as of this milestone (Sept 2026), chosen to align with the Dockerfile's databricksruntime/standard:17.3-LTS base. Never independently confirmed against a real workspace's supported version list.
new_cluster._node_type_note: AWS instance type, chosen because the project's Databricks workspace URL (dbc-01205ae9-f87b.cloud.databricks.com) is AWS-hosted. This is a plausible placeholder, not a verified/available SKU — would need to be checked against `databricks clusters list-node-types` on a real workspace before submission.
new_cluster._data_security_mode_note: Unity Catalog requires standard (shared) or dedicated (single-user) access mode — legacy 'no isolation shared' does not support Unity Catalog at all. SINGLE_USER was chosen to mirror the existing pattern in this project (a scoped identity with direct grants, same shape as test_sp's grants in ADR-007) rather than shared/multi-tenant compute. Whether SINGLE_USER + docker_image + Unity Catalog all combine cleanly together has not been verified against a real workspace — this is the single largest unverified assumption in this spec.

docker_image._docker_image_note: e.g. docker.io/<dockerhub-username>/ced-train-job:latest, once (a) the image has actually been built and (b) pushed to a registry the workspace can reach. Neither has happened. If the registry requires auth, add a basic_auth block here (username + password/token) — omitted for a public Docker Hub image.

spark_python_task._python_file_note: Must be a path the job cluster can read at run time — e.g. a Databricks Repos path (/Workspace/Repos/<user>/customer-event-detection/training/train_model_job.py) if the repo is checked out into the workspace, or a Git source block (see below) instead of a static path. Not resolved to a real path since this has never been submitted.

tasks._retry_note: 1 retry chosen to mirror the retry posture already used elsewhere in this project's Airflow DAGs, not derived from any observed failure mode of this specific job (which has never run).
